levels.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن يحيى العطار

notes: The first three co-transmitters join at «قالوا: حدثنا سعد بن عبد الله»; «أبي» is the compiler's father, a bare relation.
«قالوا أبوبصير: قال أبوعبد الله» closes with the same last two links, so no second route is written; the Imam is a narrator, written inside the chain after «عن».
«رضي الله عنهم» is an honorific and is left out.
